title: Settings
summary: The settings control the station: timezone, the stream server, Liquidsoap, rotation, outage detection, retention, and import. Everything the backend needs is set here, except the database and secrets.

entities.text: Every setting has a value from the code until you save another. The page shows whether a value is the default.
Immediate settings take effect at once. Reconnect settings take effect when their connection is opened again; changing the stream server briefly interrupts the stream.
Passwords such as the Icecast source password are set in the server environment. The panel only shows whether each one is set.
Changes that affect what goes to air are logged with their time.

usage: Open a section, change values, and save. A notice tells you when a value needs a reconnect. Leaving the page with unsaved changes asks for confirmation.
steps: Set the station timezone and name first.
Enter the stream server details and check the stream.
mistakes: Changing the stream server during an important program: the stream is interrupted briefly.
Looking for password fields. Secrets are changed in the server environment, followed by a restart.
Leaving the emergency playlist empty. Then nothing can play when the plan is empty.

example.title: Moving to a new stream server
example.text: Enter the new Icecast host and mount and save. The notice says the change applies on reconnect. Right after saving, the stream reconnects to the new server, with a short gap.

operations.edit: Each field shows its default and when a change takes effect.

station.timezone.label: Station timezone
station.timezone.text: All times in the panel and in the schedule use this zone. Default Asia/Yerevan.

stream.icecast_host.label: Icecast host
stream.icecast_host.text: The stream server the station sends to. Changing it briefly interrupts the stream.

stream.icecast_port.label: Icecast port
stream.icecast_port.text: The port of the stream server.

stream.mount.label: Mount point
stream.mount.text: The path of the stream on the server, for example /live.

stream.codec.label: Codec
stream.codec.text: The audio format of the stream.

stream.bitrate_kbps.label: Bitrate
stream.bitrate_kbps.text: Stream quality in kilobits per second.

stream.sample_rate_hz.label: Sample rate
stream.sample_rate_hz.text: Samples per second of the stream, for example 44100.

stream.loudness_target_lufs.label: Loudness target
stream.loudness_target_lufs.text: The target loudness of the stream in LUFS. The import checks tracks against it.

stream.name.label: Stream name
stream.name.text: Shown to listeners in their player.

stream.description.label: Stream description
stream.description.text: Shown to listeners in their player.

stream.hls_enabled.label: HLS
stream.hls_enabled.text: Also offer the stream as HLS for browsers and phones.

liquidsoap.music_gain.label: Music gain
liquidsoap.music_gain.text: The level of the music, 0 to 1.

liquidsoap.duck_gain.label: Music under voice
liquidsoap.duck_gain.text: The music level while live voice is on air, 0 to 1. Default 0.2.

liquidsoap.fade_out_ms.label: Fade out
liquidsoap.fade_out_ms.text: How long a track cut at a segment end fades out, 2000 to 3000 ms. Default 2500.

liquidsoap.cue_fade_in_ms.label: Default fade in at a start point
liquidsoap.cue_fade_in_ms.text: The fade in the track editor proposes when you move a start point away from the start of the file, 0 to 5000 ms. Default 1000. Each track keeps its own fade; changing this changes no track.

liquidsoap.cue_fade_out_ms.label: Default fade out at a stop point
liquidsoap.cue_fade_out_ms.text: The fade out the track editor proposes when you move a stop point away from the end of the file, 0 to 5000 ms. Default 2000. Each track keeps its own fade; changing this changes no track.

liquidsoap.harbor_port.label: Harbor port
liquidsoap.harbor_port.text: The port on which Liquidsoap receives live voice.

liquidsoap.control_host.label: Control host
liquidsoap.control_host.text: Where the backend reaches Liquidsoap's control interface.

liquidsoap.control_port.label: Control port
liquidsoap.control_port.text: The port of Liquidsoap's control interface.

liquidsoap.control_user.label: Control user
liquidsoap.control_user.text: The user name for Liquidsoap's control interface. The password is set outside the panel.

liquidsoap.media_root.label: Media folder in Liquidsoap
liquidsoap.media_root.text: The media folder as Liquidsoap sees it. Default /media.

playout.emergency_playlist_id.label: Emergency playlist
playout.emergency_playlist_id.text: Plays when no planned track is available, so the air is never silent.

playout.prepush_minutes.label: Pre-push
playout.prepush_minutes.text: Minutes before an hour starts when its first items go to Liquidsoap. From then on the hour is frozen.

air.played_count.label: Played rows
air.played_count.text: How many items that were due before the one on air the air window shows: aired, truncated, and not aired. 1 to 50.

air.queued_count.label: Queued rows
air.queued_count.text: How many planned items after the one on air the air window shows. 0 to 50; 0 shows none.

rotation.grid_horizon_days.label: Grid horizon
rotation.grid_horizon_days.text: How many days ahead the grid can be edited. 1 to 183 (six months); default 183.

rotation.plan_horizon_days.label: Plan horizon
rotation.plan_horizon_days.text: How many days ahead the track plan is kept up to date every five minutes, counted from today. 1 to 183; default 31.

rotation.full_pass_time.label: Nightly full pass at
rotation.full_pass_time.text: The station time at which every planned hour in the horizon is rebuilt once a day, as HH:MM. A change applies from the next day. Default 03:00.

rotation.full_pass_enabled.label: Nightly full pass
rotation.full_pass_enabled.text: Whether the full pass runs every night. Off stops the nightly run; the Full pass button on the Track plan page still works.

rotation.full_pass_batch_hours.label: Full pass batch
rotation.full_pass_batch_hours.text: How many planned hours one full pass rebuilds per transaction, 24 to 744. A smaller batch uses less memory and holds locks for less time. Default 168 (one week).

rotation.full_pass_slow_ms.label: Full pass slow threshold
rotation.full_pass_slow_ms.text: A full pass that takes longer than this is logged as a warning, in milliseconds. Default 60000 (one minute).

rotation.full_pass_heap_warn_mb.label: Full pass heap threshold
rotation.full_pass_heap_warn_mb.text: A full pass that uses more heap memory than this is logged as a warning, in megabytes. Default 512.

rotation.lookahead_items.label: Lookahead
rotation.lookahead_items.text: How many tracks Liquidsoap holds in advance, 2 to 3.

rotation.default_fixed_tolerance_ms.label: Default insert tolerance
rotation.default_fixed_tolerance_ms.text: The start tolerance a new timed insert or one-time insert proposes, in milliseconds. Default one minute.

rotation.min_gap_ms.label: Smallest gap for music
rotation.min_gap_ms.text: A gap between inserts shorter than this gets no music: the next insert starts earlier within its tolerance. Default 10 seconds.

outage.heartbeat_timeout_seconds.label: Heartbeat timeout
outage.heartbeat_timeout_seconds.text: Seconds without a sign from Liquidsoap before an outage is opened. Default 10.

outage.icecast_check_interval_seconds.label: Icecast check interval
outage.icecast_check_interval_seconds.text: Seconds between checks of the stream mount. Default 5.

outage.failed_checks_to_open.label: Failed checks
outage.failed_checks_to_open.text: How many checks in a row must fail before an outage is opened. Default 2.

retention.play_log_days.label: Play log days
retention.play_log_days.text: How long aired history is kept. Missed items stay until resolved. It must cover the longest interval of the play rules; a lower value is refused.

import.target_codec.label: Target codec
import.target_codec.text: The broadcast standard format for track files.

import.target_bitrate_kbps.label: Target bitrate
import.target_bitrate_kbps.text: The broadcast standard bitrate in kbps. Default 320.

import.target_sample_rate_hz.label: Target sample rate
import.target_sample_rate_hz.text: The broadcast standard sample rate. Default 44100.

import.target_channels.label: Target channels
import.target_channels.text: The broadcast standard channel count. Default 2.

import.min_bitrate_kbps.label: Lowest bitrate
import.min_bitrate_kbps.text: Lossy files below this bitrate get a quality warning. Default 128.

import.loudness_tolerance_lu.label: Loudness tolerance
import.loudness_tolerance_lu.text: How far a track may differ from the loudness target, in LU. Default 2.

import.max_true_peak_dbtp.label: Highest true peak
import.max_true_peak_dbtp.text: Tracks above this peak get a warning. Default -1 dBTP.
